akali.summary: Calm/Fury value midrange: keep the board even early with Shuriken Flip and cheap units, then land Akali, Silent, Stellacorn Herder or Irelia, Fervent when they're safe. The legend pulls a unit out of a showdown on your turn, so you win fights or leave after the opponent has spent cards.

mulligan.note: Keep two 2-cost units plus Shuriken Flip or a cheap counter; never fall behind on board early. Toss slow gear and 5-drops.

phases.name: Turns 1-3
phases.goal: Don't fall behind on board; trade early units and keep the opponent from scoring fast.
steps: Play Lonely Poro, Mournful Witness or Scuttle Crab one per battlefield (Mask/Poro reward lone units).
Use Shuriken Flip (main phase only) to kill a 2-Might unit and move your unit in to conquer.
Let Mournful Witness survive a combat so it empowers to 4 Might.
Hide Zhonya's Hourglass or Back Off at a battlefield you control when power is spare.

phases.name: Turns 4-6
phases.goal: Land Akali, Silent / Stellacorn Herder in a safe spot and win showdowns on resources.
steps: Play Akali, Silent or Herder with 1-2 energy left for Defy/Discipline, or wait a turn if behind on mana.
Move Akali, Silent to a battlefield: +2 Might, and she can't be targeted outside combat.
Move Herder to draw; if the fight turns bad, legend-retreat it to base on your turn.
Empower the legend (3 energy + 1 power) on a turn you have spare energy and both battlefields are covered.
Charm a defender away or Shuriken Flip it, then conquer the weakened battlefield.

phases.name: Closing (6+ points)
phases.goal: Lock the board with protected threats and take the last points.
steps: Play Irelia, Fervent behind Defy; legend readies give her +1 each time.
With empowered legend: attack, retreat + ready the unit, attack the other battlefield.
8th point by conquer needs both battlefields scored that turn; else hold one.
Keep a unit on the battlefield you need; don't retreat your last defender off it.

Move Herder to draw; empower legend if 4 spare and keep Defy up

no.no: Develop a 2-cost unit and hold Discipline/Defy; delay the key unit

Empowered legend also readies the retreated unit: it can move again (Herder draws, Akali +2).
Akali, Silent can be targeted in combat: protect her there with Discipline or Defy.
Shuriken Flip, Charm and Twilight Shroud are main-phase only; cast them before moving in.
Twilight Shroud before moving Herder in makes it untargetable that turn.
Back Off stuns an attacker so it deals no damage; play it from hand to draw.
Mournful Witness only empowers when a combat it was in ends: let it fight, don't retreat it.
Mask of Foresight gives +1 to a lone attacker or defender: fight with one unit per battlefield.
Inferna Ambush into your own attack after they commit: 3 Might attacker.
holdFor: Defy - counter removal aimed at Akali, Silent, Herder or Irelia, Fervent
Discipline - win a defence or a showdown and draw
Zhonya's Hourglass - hidden; saves the unit they kill
Back Off - hidden; stun their biggest attacker
Inferna - Ambush as a surprise attacker/defender body

Unfavoured. Score early with cheap units before big units land; save Defy for their key spell.
Slightly unfavoured (~46%). Pressure early and contest battlefields before Rhasa turns arrive.
Azir's lists do well into Akali. Kill Sand Soldiers with Shuriken Flip and counter Arise!.
Fury removal (Shuriken Flip) keeps Riven off a battlefield; protect your units from stuns.
Fast deck: trade early units, use Back Off on the Punch First target, retreat to dodge pumped fights.

mistakes: Falling behind on board early; the value units then can't come down safely.
Expecting the legend to save a unit on the opponent's turn: it only works on your turn.
Retreating your last unit from a battlefield and giving up the point you need.
Playing Akali, Silent/Herder into open removal mana with nothing held up.
Empowering the legend while both battlefields are left undefended.
Leaving Herder at Void Gate where enemy spells deal 1 extra damage.

notes: On own turn in a showdown that is lost or after enemy spent tricks: use legend to move the unit to base.
Once empowered, after retreat-and-ready, move the readied unit again (other battlefield or re-draw Herder).
Empower legend (3 energy + 1 power) on a turn with spare energy; never if both battlefields would be empty.
Cast Shuriken Flip in main phase before attacking; at Void Gate it deals 3.
Send one unit per battlefield when possible (Mask of Foresight, Lonely Poro).
Don't retreat Mournful Witness before combat; it empowers only after a combat ends.
Keep 1-2 energy open on opponent's turn once a key unit is on board.

azir.summary: Play one cheap Equipment a turn, then pay 1 for the legend's Sand Soldier, which equips for free. Grind with hidden removal, then Arise! and Azir - Sovereign take two battlefields at once to win.

mulligan.note: Mulligan hard for a 1-cost Equipment: without one the legend makes nothing. Keep a cheap trick only next to it.

phases.name: Turns 1-3
phases.goal: Make a Sand Soldier every turn and take the first battlefield.
steps: Play exactly one 1-cost Equipment (Soul Sword, Doran's Shield, Eye of the Herald), then pay 1 for the legend's Soldier.
Let Weaponmaster equip the new Soldier for free; it enters exhausted at base and moves next turn.
Holding Ornn's Forge makes your first non-token gear each turn 1 cheaper, so a 1-cost gear is free.
Move ready Soldiers to an empty battlefield; Trifarian War Camp gives +1 Might to the wider side.
Once you hold a battlefield, hide Guards!, Hidden Blade or Back Off there for 1 power.

phases.name: Turns 4-6
phases.goal: Go wide on both battlefields and win the trades with reactions.
steps: Keep one Equipment plus legend per turn; upgrade to Brutalizer or B.F. Sword (Soldier with Sword = 5 Might).
Play Guards! from hidden when they attack, paying Order to ready the Soldier.
Kill their key attacker with Hidden Blade or stun it with Back Off; Defy their removal.
Sacrifice a 5+ Might Soldier that is about to die: draw 2 and ramp; its Equipment stays.
Conquer Hall of Legends to ready the legend and make a second Soldier that turn.

phases.name: Closing (6+ points)
phases.goal: Take both battlefields in one turn for the final point.
steps: The final point by conquest needs every battlefield scored that turn, so plan a double conquer.
Count Equipment on board, then cast Arise!: one Soldier each, two of them ready.
Conquer one battlefield with tokens, then play Azir - Sovereign with Accelerate and attack the other.
Sovereign's attack moves any of your tokens to him; keep Defy or Discipline for their answer.
If you can't double-conquer, hold both battlefields and score the last point at turn start.

tree.yes: Conquer one with tokens; Accelerate Azir - Sovereign into the other

no.q: Do you control 3+ Equipment and have 6 energy for Arise!?

yes.yes: Cast Arise!, send the two ready Soldiers to conquer
yes.no: Play Equipment + legend Soldier; save Arise! for a bigger board

no.q: Do you have an Equipment and 1 extra energy for the legend?

yes.q: Does an enemy unit threaten a battlefield you hold?
yes.yes: Make the Soldier, then hide Guards!/Hidden Blade there; keep Defy up
yes.no: Play 1 Equipment, legend Soldier, equip; move ready units to open field

no.no: Play Desert's Call or hide Guards!; hold Defy/Discipline for their turn

combat: Defend with hidden Guards!: the new Soldier joins the fight and Weaponmaster can grab an Equipment.
Hidden Blade the biggest attacker at your battlefield; accept that its owner draws 2.
Back Off from hidden stuns an attacker for 0 energy; from hand it also draws 1.
Defy the removal spell that would break a big Soldier or Sovereign's attack.
Deathgrip a spare Soldier or Recruit to pump the unit that decides the fight, and draw 1.
Discipline is +2 and a card: best on the defender that otherwise loses by 1-2 Might.

matchups.plan: Favourable. Go wide so their lone-defender +2 matters less; Charm or Hidden Blade the lone holder.
Favourable per tier list. Trade tokens for her units and keep hidden removal at your battlefield.
Difficult. Few units on her side, so Hidden Blade/Back Off her main threat and race on the other field.
Difficult. Score fast before his late game; don't overextend Equipment into board-wide answers.
Difficult. Pressure early with equipped Soldiers and keep Defy for her key spells.
Difficult. He out-sizes your Soldiers early; stack Brutalizer/B.F. Sword and stun his attacker.

mistakes: Playing two Equipment in one turn: you run out of units, and the legend only makes one Soldier.
Playing an Equipment without 1 energy left for the legend.
Using Azir - Sovereign early instead of saving him for the double-conquer finish.
Holding Deathgrip for late game; it is best early to win small fights and draw.
Building one huge Soldier and leaving the other battlefield and next turn short on power.
Casting Arise! with few Equipment on board.

notes: Each turn: play exactly one Equipment, then always use the legend (1 energy) the same turn.
Never play a second Equipment in a turn unless the extra Might wins a fight now.
Prefer equipping Soldiers via Weaponmaster over paying equip costs on other units.
Hide Guards!/Hidden Blade/Back Off at a battlefield you control once you hold one.
Hold Azir - Sovereign until he can attack (Accelerate) the second battlefield on a scoring turn.
Arise! only with 3+ Equipment in play; it readies two Soldiers to conquer that turn.
Sacrifice only a Mighty (5+) unit that is about to die or has done its job.
In this game Eye of the Herald gives +0 Might; it is a 1-cost legend trigger only.

evelynn.summary: Aggressive hidden-card deck: hide units and tricks at battlefields you hold, then flip them on your own turn to draw (legend) and swing fights. The opponent must either attack into unknown cards or let you hold for free.

mulligan.note: Keep cheap Hidden units and 3-drops so you can conquer early and start hiding. Big units and pump spells go back (inferred from curve).

phases.name: Turns 1-3
phases.goal: Conquer a battlefield and start hiding cards there.
steps: Take an empty battlefield early; Bandle Scouts' Academy is best: each hide there gives a Gold gear.
Hide Evelynn - Entrancing, Pyke - Returned or Tornado Warrior at the battlefield you hold.
Gutter Guardian: show off a Hidden card in hand for an extra rune.
Kinkou Initiate draws if your other units total 5+ Might; Ezreal digs (discard 1, draw 2).

phases.name: Turns 4-6
phases.goal: Flip hidden cards on your turn for card draw and surprise conquers.
steps: Flip one hidden card each of your turns: legend draws 1 with no discard.
Flip Evelynn - Entrancing on your turn to drag an enemy unit to her battlefield, then fight it.
After a flip, Hold 'Em costs 1 (you played a unit to a battlefield): +3 Might to win the fight.
Rengar - Trophy Hunter can be played straight to a battlefield with enemy units.
Rampage (pay Body for +2) as removal; Fizz - Trickster recasts Rampage or Hold 'Em from trash.

phases.name: Closing (6+ points)
phases.goal: Overload the last fight and keep scoring holds.
steps: Tail-Cloaked Matriarch: empower to replay a 3-cost unit from trash (Pyke, Evelynn).
Flip Tornado Warrior next to Matriarch or Kharox to empower it for free that turn (inferred).
Onslaught (+6) or Baron Nashor (+2 to others) for the final conquer.
Keep a face-down card at each battlefield you hold so the opponent must guess.

yes.q: Do you have spare power (1 rune or Gold gear) to hide?
yes.yes: Hide Evelynn/Pyke/Tornado Warrior there (Academy gives Gold gear)
yes.no: Play Gutter Guardian/Kinkou to base or battlefield, hide next turn

no.q: Is there a hidden card you can flip this turn (not hidden this turn)?

yes.q: Would the flip let you win a conquer this turn?
Is the enemy unit at another location?
yes.yes: Flip Evelynn - Entrancing to drag it in, then attack
yes.no: Flip unit/Edge of Night, add Hold 'Em, attack
Flip on your turn anyway for the clean legend draw; keep 1 hidden

no.q: Is any battlefield empty or weakly held?
no.yes: Conquer it; Rengar - Trophy Hunter can drop onto enemy units
no.no: Develop Matriarch/K'Sante, keep Star-Crossed up

combat: Legend draws once per turn on a face-down play; on their turn you must also discard, so prefer your turn.
Flip a hidden unit mid-showdown to add Might when they attack your battlefield.
Switcheroo (hidden) swaps Might of two units at one battlefield; best vs their single big unit.
Hold 'Em costs 1 after you play a unit/gear to a battlefield this turn, including a hidden flip.
Rampage = removal: friendly and enemy deal damage equal to Might to each other; pay Body for +2.
Star-Crossed bounces their best unit and saves yours from removal.

matchups.plan: Riven plays units ready on held battlefields; contest early, drag her Blade unit with Entrancing (inferred).
Bounce undoes hidden setup less than played units; keep cards face down and flip on your turn (inferred).
Riftbound.gg says Evelynn does well vs beefy units; use Switcheroo/Star-Crossed on big ones (Azir fit inferred).
Spell removal is her weak spot (riftbound.gg); keep units hidden until the flip wins the fight (inferred).

mistakes: Flipping on the opponent's turn just for the draw: you also discard 1.
Hiding where you can't hold; hidden cards at a lost battlefield are wasted.
Running out of power to hide; use Bandle Scouts' Academy, Pyke and Gutter Guardian for runes.
Flipping Evelynn - Entrancing on their turn: the drag only works on your turn.

notes: Each turn, keep at least one face-down card at every battlefield you hold if you can pay.
Flip the first hidden card on your own turn (draw without discard).
Hide on Bandle Scouts' Academy first when you control it (free Gold gear).
Cast Hold 'Em only after playing a unit or gear to a battlefield this turn (costs 1).

irelia.summary: Calm/Chaos tempo-value: land Irelia, Fervent or Stellacorn Herder, then choose them with cheap tricks so the legend readies them for extra moves, draws and conquers. Cheap reactions and counters protect the one or two key units while you out-card the opponent.

mulligan.note: Keep a cheap unit, both domains and one cheap trick or counter. Send back gear and 3-cost answers when you have no unit to use them on.

phases.name: Turns 1-3
phases.goal: Contest the first battlefield cheaply and set up hidden cards without falling behind.
steps: Turn 2: Scuttle Crab (draws) or Tideturner to a battlefield.
Hide Tideturner or Zhonya's Hourglass at a battlefield you control (1 power).
Turn 3-4: Stellacorn Herder or Akali, Silent; keep 1-2 energy up for Defy or Discipline.

phases.goal: Land Irelia, Fervent and start the choose-and-ready loop that wins fights and draws cards.
steps: Play Irelia, Fervent when you can still hold 1-2 energy for Defy/Discipline after.
Move Fervent or Herder in; Herder draws on every move.
In the showdown, choose your exhausted unit with Discipline/En Garde/Defiant Dance, pay 1 power: legend readies it.
After a conquer, pay 1 energy to ready the legend for a second ready this turn.
Move readied Herder/Fervent back to base at end of turn; leave a cheap unit to hold.
Equip Boots of Swiftness (Ganking) so a readied unit can jump to the other battlefield.

Keep Defy, Not So Fast or Abandon for the spell that would decide the final point.
Put Vex, Apathetic on the battlefield you hold so new enemy units get stunned.
Hidden Tideturner swaps Fervent in from base when they attack your held battlefield.
Save the last ready until the opponent has committed; count their move options first.

yes.yes: Gust it (hold for their attack) and play Scuttle Crab to contest

jayce.summary: Ramp with Platewyrm Egg, Mobilize and Catalyst, then land Dazzling Aurora. Elder Dragon is the only unit in the deck, so Aurora drops one every turn and 1-damage spells wipe boards.

mulligan.note: Keep ramp (Egg, Mobilize, Catalyst) plus Aurora or Promising Future. Elder in hand is dead weight: it belongs in the deck.

phases.name: Turns 1-3
phases.goal: Build energy toward a turn 3-4 Aurora while slowing early scorers.
steps: Turn 1-2: Mobilize and Catalyst of Aeons channel exhausted runes for next turn.
Play Platewyrm Egg early: it enters exhausted, then empower it (1 energy) so it adds 2 energy.
Use the legend (1 energy, exhaust) to ready an empowered Egg for +1 net energy.
Promising Future: take Dazzling Aurora (2 power); it plays an Elder at end of your turn anyway.
Bellows Breath or Flurry of Blades only on cheap units that would score; Sabotage their gear removal.

phases.name: Turns 4-6
phases.goal: Resolve Dazzling Aurora and let Elder Dragons lock the board.
steps: Cast Dazzling Aurora as soon as the Egg and legend reach 9 energy; it plays an Elder each end step.
Elder's entry pings one enemy per location; with Elder out any damage you deal kills.
Next turn, Flurry of Blades kills every enemy at battlefields; Bellows Breath kills up to 3 (6 with Repeat).
Clairvoyance at the end of their turn: recycle any Elder you would draw so Aurora still finds it.
Play Jayce, Brilliant Inventor to ready an Egg or rune; empower the legend to ready 2 gear.

phases.name: Closing (6+ points)
phases.goal: Walk Elder Dragons onto both battlefields and score.
steps: Move ready Elders to both battlefields; 10 Might plus lethal damage wins any combat.
Sprite Burst gives two ready 3-Might bodies to grab an empty battlefield the same turn.
Final point by conquest needs both battlefields scored that turn; otherwise hold and score at turn start.
If Elders are gone, Gutter Palace Birds go to battlefields: 4 cards in hand + 4 units there wins.
Rocket Barrage kills a gear or deals 4 to a unit in base to clear the last blocker.

yes.q: Are 2+ enemy units at battlefields?
yes.yes: Cast Flurry of Blades or Bellows Breath: every hit kills
yes.no: Move ready Elder to the weakest battlefield and conquer

no.q: Is Dazzling Aurora in play (Elder still in deck)?
no.yes: Hold Flurry/Bellows for their units; Aurora plays Elder at end of turn

no.q: Can you reach 9 energy for Aurora, or cast Promising Future?
no.yes: Cast Dazzling Aurora; else Promising Future and pick Aurora

no.q: Is an enemy unit about to score on a battlefield?
no.yes: Bellows Breath/Flurry it, or Sprite Burst to contest
no.no: Ramp: Mobilize, Catalyst, Platewyrm Egg; empower the Egg

combat: With Elder Dragon out, 1 damage kills: Flurry of Blades (reaction) wipes enemies at battlefields.
Flurry also hits your own units at battlefields; Birds and Sprites there die too.
Pre-Elder, Bellows Breath (3 targets, Repeat for 3 more) clears 1-Might tokens and wounded units.
Keep Platewyrm Egg ready: its energy ability is a Reaction, so it pays for showdown spells.
Downstage Dramatics and Clairvoyance are Reactions: cast them at end of the opponent's turn.

matchups.plan: Unfavourable: Kennen beats Jayce per tier list. Sabotage key spells and race Aurora down fast.
Favourable. His lone defender dies to any Elder ping; Sabotage Zhonya's or Defy before Aurora.
Favourable per tier list. Bellows Breath her small units, then Aurora lock.
Aurora is good vs fast decks if it lands early. Use Forgotten Monument and early pings.
Bounce (Star-Crossed, Rebuke) resets Elder; bait it out, keep Elders in deck for Aurora.
Order removal (Hidden Blade) kills Elder; keep Flurry for Sand Soldier swarms.
